messages.title: A sun-safe glow for {{salon_name}}?
messages.preview: The professional tan behind Jimmy Coco's work — a complimentary trial for your booth before summer.
messages.headline: A Sydney glow, without the Sydney sun.

blocks.html: Hi {{first_name}},

I'll keep this short. I look after salon partnerships for Sunless by Jimmy Coco — the professional line from tanning artist Jimmy Coco, the name behind a lot of the colour you've seen on red carpets and in front of cameras.

Your clients want that warm, lit-from-within colour all year — but under some of the harshest UV on earth, more of them would rather not earn it on the sand or in a bed. Our Sunset professional solution gives them a believable, sun-safe alternative: undertone-true colour that reads natural in daylight, never orange, never flat.
It's also built to behave in a Sydney summer — even wear and a clean fade, not a patchy result by the weekend.
Could I post {{salon_name}} a complimentary trial of the Sunset solution and Jimmy's shade guide — no cost, no commitment?
Or just reply 'send it' — that's all I need.

messages.title: re: colour that survives a Sydney summer
messages.preview: Undertone-true colour, built to stay believable in harbour light and hold through the humidity.
messages.headline: Believable in the light. Steady in the humidity.

blocks.html: Hi {{first_name}},

Floating this back to the top of your inbox. The real test of a professional tan isn't the treatment room — it's a client at Bondi at midday, in the photos from a February wedding, or out on the harbour three days later.

That's what Jimmy's shade method is built for: controlled depth, undertone awareness, and a finish that looks considered rather than obvious — one that wears and fades evenly through a humid Sydney week instead of patching off.

items: A more confident consultation with every client
Colour clients can wear to weddings, events and a long weekend away
A premium result that doesn't lean on discounting
A name your clients already recognise

blocks.html: The complimentary trial offer still stands — a Sunset sample and Jimmy's shade guide, posted to {{salon_name}} so you can judge the colour on a real client.
A one-word reply is plenty.

messages.title: Two tan revenue lines, one partner
messages.preview: Your booth and your retail shelf, working together — without discounting.
messages.headline: One partner. Two ways to earn.

blocks.html: Hi {{first_name}},
A quick note on why Jimmy Coco tends to pay for itself — it works two ways inside the same salon:

items: In the booth: the Sunset professional solution — believable, buildable colour you can price and present as a premium service, not a race to the bottom.
On the shelf: a curated take-home range so clients can keep their colour fresh between visits — real margin, no extra chair time.

blocks.html: One partner, one aesthetic and two commercial moments from the same client relationship — and the moment a client walks out of your booth is the highest-intent one you get.
The exact range and trade terms are confirmed through the approved partner route — I won't quote anything I can't stand behind. Happy to walk you through it on a quick call.
The complimentary trial is still open too — just say the word.

messages.title: Your summer is booked before summer starts
messages.preview: Trial, training and first stock are all easier before the season lands.
messages.headline: Your busy season starts before the bookings do.

blocks.html: Hi {{first_name}},

It's the quiet part of the year for tanning, which is exactly why it's the right time to talk. Sydney's demand never really switches off — but it climbs hard through spring and summer: race day, spring and autumn weddings, Christmas parties, New Year on the harbour, and a long run of beach weekends.

Salons that are ready early win that whole stretch. Getting ready takes a few weeks — trial the solution, train the team on Jimmy's shade method, and choose an opening range — so the calm window now is the advantage.

items: Trial the professional solution on a real client
Train the team on shade selection and application
Choose the opening booth and take-home range
Have launch assets ready before demand peaks

blocks.html: This isn't a discount play. It's a premium service system designed to help {{salon_name}} walk into the season prepared and confident.
A complimentary trial is the easiest place to start — reply and I'll arrange it.

messages.title: Shall I close the file?
messages.preview: Closing this out — but the shade guide is yours to keep.
messages.headline: I'll leave it there.

blocks.html: Hi {{first_name}},
I've reached out a couple of times about getting {{salon_name}} set up with Jimmy Coco before summer, and haven't heard back — which is completely fine. I won't keep filling your inbox.
I'll close the file for now. If the timing's just off, reply any time and I'll pick it straight back up — there's no deadline and nothing expires.
Either way, here's Jimmy's shade guide to keep — it's genuinely useful for any solution you're working with.
Thanks for reading — I appreciate your time.
